#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent GNU patch replay; no authoring helper or product mutation."""
import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
import json,hashlib,subprocess,tempfile,collections
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path.cwd();TMP=Path('/tmp/fgos-work/w11-g9')
HERE=ROOT/'plans/260925-documentation-authority-unification/reports/phase-09/composition'
packet=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else HERE/'patch-specs.json').read_text())
approved=json.loads((HERE.parent.parent/'phase-08/step-07-composed-patches.json').read_text())['patches']
byid={s['id']:s for s in packet['patches']};byexternal={s['patchSpecId']:s for s in approved}
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
commands=[];roundtrips=[];edges=[]
def patch(d,path,before,diff,expected):
 print('patch',path,file=sys.stderr,flush=True)
 p=Path(d)/path;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(before)
 if diff:
  r=subprocess.run(['patch','--batch','--fuzz=0','-p1'],cwd=d,input=diff.encode(),capture_output=True)
  commands.append(dict(argv=['patch','--batch','--fuzz=0','-p1'],cwd=d,exit=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout.decode(),stderr=r.stderr.decode()))
  assert r.returncode==0,(path,r.stdout,r.stderr)
 after=p.read_bytes();assert sha(after)==expected,(path,sha(after),expected)
 return after
ids=packet['effectiveSpecIds']+packet['finalPinFSpecIds'];assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))
byfile=collections.defaultdict(list)
for i in ids:byfile[byid[i]['path']].append(byid[i])
for path,specs in byfile.items():
 p=ROOT/path;exists=p.exists();before=p.read_bytes() if exists else b'';text=before;steps=[]
 first=specs[0]
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=TMP,prefix='independent-') as d:
  if sha(text)!=first['beforeSha256']:
   pred=first.get('predecessor');assert pred and pred['patchSpecId'] in byexternal,(path,'missing external root')
   ext=byexternal[pred['patchSpecId']];assert ext['path']==path and sha(text)==ext['beforeSha256'],path
   text=patch(d,path,text,ext['diff'],ext['expectedAfterSha256']);steps.append(ext)
  for s in specs:
   assert sha(text)==s['beforeSha256'],s['id']
   if s.get('requiresAbsent'):assert not exists
   if s.get('predecessor'):
    pred=s['predecessor'];parent=byid.get(pred['patchSpecId']) or byexternal[pred['patchSpecId']]
    assert s['beforeSha256']==pred['expectedAfterSha256']==parent['expectedAfterSha256'],s['id']
    edges.append(dict(specId=s['id'],predecessor=pred['patchSpecId'],valid=True))
   text=patch(d,path,text,s['diff'],s['expectedAfterSha256']);steps.append(s)
  end=sha(text)
  for s in reversed(steps):text=patch(d,path,text,s['rollbackDiff'],s['beforeSha256'])
  assert text==before
  if not exists:(Path(d)/path).unlink();assert not (Path(d)/path).exists()
  roundtrips.append(dict(path=path,specIds=[s['id'] for s in specs],currentSha256=sha(before),expectedAfterSha256=end,forwardExit=0,rollbackExit=0,forwardAndRollbackExactBytes=True,initiallyAbsent=not exists))
# Generator evidence must also be reversible but is never an application door.
generated=[]
for s in packet.get('generatorEvidenceSpecIds',[]):
 spec=byid[s];path=spec['path'];before=(ROOT/path).read_bytes()
 if sha(before)!=spec['beforeSha256']:
  pred=byid[spec['predecessor']['patchSpecId']]
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=TMP,prefix='generator-') as d:before=patch(d,path,before,pred['diff'],pred['expectedAfterSha256'])
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=TMP,prefix='generator-') as d:
  after=patch(d,path,before,spec['diff'],spec['expectedAfterSha256'])
  assert patch(d,path,after,spec['rollbackDiff'],spec['beforeSha256'])==before
 generated.append(dict(specId=s,forwardExit=0,rollbackExit=0,exactBytes=True))
print(json.dumps(dict(sourceCommit=packet['sourceCommit'],exit=0,effectiveSpecs=len(packet['effectiveSpecIds']),deferredFinalPinFSpecs=len(packet['finalPinFSpecIds']),files=len(roundtrips),patchInvocations=len(commands),filesVerified=roundtrips,edges=edges,generatorEvidence=generated,commands=commands,interpretation='Byte evidence, not source conservation acceptance, semantic approval, gate closure or full-suite parity.'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
